Android only. macOS and iOS remain the 0.1.0 builds.

## Android (arm64, Android 13+)

`edge0-0.1.1-android-arm64.apk`

Built from `d4a2fa02fcf0` on `main`, which includes https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/pull/155. versionName 0.1.1 (versionCode 2), arm64-v8a only. Signed with the same certificate as 0.1.0, so it can replace that install. Not published on Google Play. Allow installation from this source, then open the APK.

Models has Import. Choose a `.gguf` and the app copies it into its private storage. USB debugging is not required. For 8B, import `lora_edge0_8b-gguf.gguf` the same way, then load the model.

detail.readme:
# edge0 **An open-source streaming MoE inference framework — SSD expert offload + Recover-LoRA + prerouter routing prediction.** **macOS** · **iOS** · **Android** · **Windows** — one engine, one native API. [![Hugging Face](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%A4%97%20Hugging%20Face-Edge0--35B--A3B--preview-yellow?style=for-the-badge)](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) [![Hugging Face](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%A4%97%20Hugging%20Face-Edge0--8B--A1B--preview-yellow?style=for-the-badge)](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) [![ModelScope](https://img.shields.io/badge/ModelScope-Edge0--35B--A3B--preview-624AFF?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) [![ModelScope](https://img.shields.io/badge/ModelScope-Edge0--8B--A1B--preview-624AFF?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) [![arXiv](https://img.shields.io/badge/arXiv-2609.18063-B31B1B?style=for-the-badge&logo=arxiv&logoColor=white)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18063) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Edge0--AI%2FEdge0-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20us-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://edge0.ai/discord) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE) English | [中文](README_zh.md) | [日本語](README_ja.md) | [Español](README_es.md) | [Français](README_fr.md)
## News - **[2026-11-04]** We released the **unified inference engine [`edge0-infer`](edge0-infer/README.md)**: built on [GGML](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml), one engine and one native C++ API run the same model on macOS, iOS, Android and Windows, with a CLI, an OpenAI-compatible local server, and chat app examples for desktop, Android and iOS. The first release supports `edge0-35b`; `edge0-8b` follows in a later release. It replaces the Python framework and the per-platform engines; the previous code is kept at tag [`pre-edge0-infer`](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/tree/pre-edge0-infer). - **[2026-09-30]** We released the **edge0 inference engines for four platforms — iOS, macOS, Android and Windows** (source at tag [`pre-edge0-infer`](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/tree/pre-edge0-infer)). - **[2026-09-16]** Our technical report is on arXiv: [The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18063). - **[2026-09-08]** Initial open-source release of **edge0**, together with both model tiers — [`Edge0-35B-A3B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) and [`Edge0-8B-A1B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) — on Hugging Face and ModelScope. ## About **edge0** is an open-source streaming MoE inference framework. It generalizes the production-proven recipe — **SSD expert offload + Recover-LoRA + prerouter routing prediction** — into an extensible framework that runs large sparse-MoE models on consumer hardware: peak memory is bounded by the *active* expert set, not the parameter count. ### Core mechanisms - **SSD expert offload**: expert weights are streamed from storage on demand; peak memory is bounded by the active set, not the parameter count. - **Prerouter**: a trained head predicts expert routing one step ahead, so expert loads overlap the forward pass instead of stalling it — **up to +59%** decode throughput; the gain grows with storage latency, model size, and routed width *K*. - **Recover-LoRA**: the int4 base is frozen and LoRA adapters are trained by distillation from the FP teacher, recovering most of the quantization loss at 4-bit (see [Quality](#quality)). Adapters are stored separately from the base and can be switched on or off. ### Platforms One engine and one native API, with the same code on every platform — see [`edge0-infer/`](edge0-infer/README.md): | Platform | Backends | Verified on | |---|---|---| | **macOS** (Apple Silicon) | Metal, CPU | Apple M5, 16 GiB | | **iOS** | Metal | iPhone 17 Pro Max | | **Android** | CPU | OnePlus PKR110 (Snapdragon 8 Elite) | | **Windows** (x86-64) | CPU, Vulkan | Intel Core i5-12400, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER | Prefill and decode can run on different backends of the same device, for example Metal prefill with CPU decode. Chat app examples for desktop (macOS, Windows), Android and iOS are in [`edge0-infer/examples/`](edge0-infer/examples/README.md#chat-applications). ### Models Two model tiers ship with the framework. Each tier is an end-to-end release: the released checkpoint, the trained LoRA adapters, and the trained prerouter heads work together as one unit. | Tier | Released checkpoint | Inference profile | edge0-infer | |---|---|---|---| | `edge0-35b` | [`Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) · [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) | 4-bit, 40 layers, 256 experts, prerouter K=4 | ✅ Supported | | `edge0-8b` | [`Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) · [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) | 4-bit, 24 layers, 128 experts, prerouter K=8 | Planned | Both checkpoints are built on open sparse-MoE base models (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and the Ling 3.0 bailing hybrid respectively) and ship with the LoRA and prerouter training done for this framework. edge0-infer downloads the released checkpoint with its asset tools and converts it into the engine's model assets (see [Getting Started](#getting-started)). ### Design - **GGML-based, the same code on every platform**: the native library depends only on GGML, vendored unmodified at a fixed version; the build downloads nothing; - **One native API**: applications link the CMake target `edge0::edge0` and include the headers in `include/edge0/` to use the engine in process; the reference CLI and the OpenAI-compatible server use the same settings and defaults as the native API; - **Experts on demand**: routed experts are read from storage on demand into a fixed number of expert slots per layer, so a model larger than the device memory budget runs without being loaded whole; - **Two routing modes**: `predicted` (default) uses the prerouter to prepare the next token's experts in the background while the current token computes; `actual` is the model's original computation, for comparison; - **Multi-turn reuse**: in a multi-turn conversation usually only each turn's new message is computed; earlier results are reused. See the [edge0-infer architecture](edge0-infer/docs/architecture.md). ### Quality All benchmarks were run by us with [OpenCompass](https://github.com/open-compass/opencompass) under identical settings and parameters for both the edge0 models (int4 + trained adapters + prerouter routing) and the original fp16 base models. The loss of the edge0 pipeline is small: **3.9 points on average for edge0-35b, 2.8 for edge0-8b** (MMLU-Pro is even above the base). Max 100: | Benchmark | edge0-35b (int4) | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (fp16) | edge0-8b (int4) | Ling 3.0 tiny (fp16) | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | AIME 2026 | 86.6 | 92.7 | 63.3 | 73.3 | | HumanEval | 90.9 | 95.1 | 91.5 | 92.7 | | GPQA-Diamond | 79.8 | 81.8 | 70.7 | 71.2 | | MMLU-Pro | 81.0 | 84.6 | 70.1 | 65.8 | | IFBench | 57.9 | 61.7 | 53.9 | 60.6 | | **Average** | **79.2** | **83.2** | **69.9** | **72.7** | ### Benchmark `edge0-35b` with `predicted` routing, measured with edge0-infer (each range is the minimum to maximum of three processes): | Platform | Device | Prompt | First token | Decode speed | Memory peak | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | macOS Metal | Apple M5, 16 GiB | 3,084 tokens | 5.60–5.87 s | 24.8–24.9 tok/s | 3.43 GiB (`phys_footprint`) | | macOS CPU | Apple M5, 16 GiB | 627 tokens | 11.5–11.7 s | 21.7–22.3 tok/s | 2.96 GiB (`phys_footprint`) | | iOS Metal | iPhone 17 Pro Max, 12 GB | 627 tokens | 8.20–8.26 s | 13.2 tok/s | 3.05 GiB (`phys_footprint`) | | Android CPU | OnePlus PKR110, 16 GB | 627 tokens | 18.4–18.8 s | 11.4–11.8 tok/s | 2.82 GiB (RSS) | | Windows CPU | Intel Core i5-12400, 32 GB | 627 tokens | 16.9–17.3 s | 7.3–8.2 tok/s | 2.86 GiB (working set) | | Windows Vulkan (both phases, 32 expert slots) | RTX 4070 SUPER, 12 GB | 627 tokens | 3.75–3.76 s | 23.6–24.0 tok/s | GPU memory increase 5.35 GiB | Memory metrics differ by platform and cannot be compared directly. The measurement method, the `actual` routing figures and the commands to reproduce them are in [Benchmarking](edge0-infer/docs/benchmarking.md#reference-figures). ## Getting Started Run the following commands in `edge0-infer/`. You need CMake 3.21+, Ninja, a C++17/C11 compiler, uv and Git; the 35B needs about 18 GB for the original weights and about 20 GB for the converted assets, plus as much free space again while converting. ### 1) Build ```bash cd edge0-infer cmake --preset mac-metal && cmake --build --preset mac-metal build/mac-metal/bin/edge0-infer info # expect a line: model.0: edge0_35b ``` On machines without Metal use `--preset cpu`, `build/cpu/bin/edge0-infer`, and `--device cpu` in the commands below. ### 2) Download and convert the model assets ```bash export MOE_SOURCE_35B= export MOE_ASSETS_35B= uv sync --project tools/assets assets_py() { uv run --project tools/assets --offline --no-sync python -I "$@"; } assets_py tools/assets/edge0_35b/fetch_source.py download --out "$MOE_SOURCE_35B" assets_py tools/assets/edge0_35b/make_assets.py --source "$MOE_SOURCE_35B" --out "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" assets_py tools/assets/check_assets.py check "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" ``` This downloads `Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview` from Hugging Face and checks it against the locked revision and digests. ### 3) Run ```bash # one prompt build/mac-metal/bin/edge0-infer run --model "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" --device metal --user "Introduce yourself in one sentence." # multi-turn chat build/mac-metal/bin/edge0-infer chat --model "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" --device metal # serve (OpenAI-compatible, default http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1) build/mac-metal/bin/edge0-infer serve --model "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" --device metal ``` For the Android, Windows and iOS builds, and for using the engine from your own CMake project, see [Getting started](edge0-infer/docs/getting-started.md). ## Documentation **Models** - [MoE routing and experts](docs/moe.md) / [prerouter](docs/prerouter.md) - [edge0-35b](docs/models/edge0-35b.md) / [edge0-8b](docs/models/edge0-8b.md) - Technical report: [The Other Half of the Memory Wall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18063) ([PDF](paper/main.pdf)) **Engine (edge0-infer)** - [Getting started](edge0-infer/docs/getting-started.md): build, model assets, run, chat and serve on every platform - [Configuration](edge0-infer/docs/configuration.md) / [Native API](edge0-infer/docs/native-api.md) / [OpenAI-compatible server](edge0-infer/docs/openai-compatible-server.md) - [Architecture](edge0-infer/docs/architecture.md) / [Known limitations](edge0-infer/docs/limitations.md) - [Benchmarking](edge0-infer/docs/benchmarking.md) / [Testing](edge0-infer/docs/testing.md) - [Model asset tools and adding a model](edge0-infer/tools/assets/README.md) ## Roadmap ### Q4 2026 **Platforms & systems** - ✅ **edge0 unified inference engine open-sourced** (2026-11-04) — [`edge0-infer`](edge0-infer/README.md): one engine and one native API across macOS, iOS, Android and Windows. - **`edge0-8b` support in edge0-infer**. **Models & algorithms** Q4 works two fronts: bringing a next-generation architecture into the framework, and turning latent reasoning into a real latency saving rather than just an arithmetic one. - **Next-gen architecture support (Qwen3.8-Flash class)** — run hybrid linear attention (GDN + QSA), gated multi-branch residual, and N-gram embedding topologies on edge0. These designs suit SSD streaming offload naturally: O(1)-state attention keeps long thinking from becoming a KV-cache problem, and lookup-only N-gram tables stream on demand. Goal: the tier runs on a single device and benchmarks within an acceptable gap of the fp16 base. - **Latent thinking + batched expert pre-prediction** — make latent reasoning a *latency* saving, not only an arithmetic one. The core engineering problem: move expert routing from per-position to **once per block**, so one prediction covers every position and round of a block and **expert load volume decouples from the reasoning loop count** — plus cross-block prefetch that loads the next block's experts inside the current block's compute window. Progress is measured as **end-to-end thinking-phase time at matched accuracy** (never tokens/s). - More model tiers and adapter releases on the existing pipeline. ## Contributing Contributions are welcome — issues, PRs, benchmark reports and model ports all count. Building and testing are described in [Testing](edge0-infer/docs/testing.md); the checks that need no model assets: ```bash cd edge0-infer cmake --preset cpu && cmake --build --preset cpu ctest --preset cpu -L "L0|L1" ``` For changes under `edge0-infer/`, open issues and PRs in this repository as usual; the directory is developed in a separate repository, and an accepted change is applied there first by the maintainers and arrives here with the next sync. See [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md). Workflow: fork → feature branch → PR against `main`. Please keep the tests passing and add tests for new behavior. ## Citation If you find edge0 useful, please cite our technical report: ```bibtex @article{lin2026other, title = {The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction}, author = {Lin, Yu and Wang, Yiming and Cai, Runyuan and Liu, Hanze and Zeng, Xiaodong}, journal = {arXiv preprint arXiv:2609.18063}, year = {2026}, url = {https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18063} } ``` ## Contact Us - **Discord**: [edge0.ai/discord](https://edge0.ai/discord) — community chat and support - **Email**: samuel@edge0.ai For bugs and feature requests, please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/issues). ## License Apache-2.0; bundled third-party components keep their own licenses (see [NOTICE](NOTICE)).

# edge0 **开源流式 MoE 推理框架 —— SSD 专家 offload + Recover-LoRA + prerouter 路由预判** **macOS** · **iOS** · **Android** · **Windows** —— 一个引擎，一套原生 API。 [![Hugging Face](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%A4%97%20Hugging%20Face-Edge0--35B--A3B--preview-yellow?style=for-the-badge)](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) [![Hugging Face](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%A4%97%20Hugging%20Face-Edge0--8B--A1B--preview-yellow?style=for-the-badge)](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) [![ModelScope](https://img.shields.io/badge/ModelScope-Edge0--35B--A3B--preview-624AFF?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) [![ModelScope](https://img.shields.io/badge/ModelScope-Edge0--8B--A1B--preview-624AFF?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) [![arXiv](https://img.shields.io/badge/arXiv-2609.18063-B31B1B?style=for-the-badge&logo=arxiv&logoColor=white)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18063) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Edge0--AI%2FEdge0-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20us-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://edge0.ai/discord) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE) [English](README.md) | 中文 | [日本語](README_ja.md) | [Español](README_es.md) | [Français](README_fr.md)
## 新闻 - **【2026-11-04】** 发布**统一推理引擎 [`edge0-infer`](edge0-infer/README_zh.md)**： 基于 [GGML](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml)，一个引擎、一套原生 C++ API， 在 macOS、iOS、Android、Windows 上运行同一个模型，并附带 CLI、OpenAI 兼容 本地服务，以及桌面、Android、iOS 对话 App 示例。首版支持 `edge0-35b`， `edge0-8b` 将在后续版本支持。它取代了原 Python 框架与四端各自的引擎， 旧版代码保留在 tag [`pre-edge0-infer`](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/tree/pre-edge0-infer)。 - **【2026-09-30】** 我们发布了**四端推理引擎**，适配 iOS、macOS、 Android、Windows 平台（源码见 tag [`pre-edge0-infer`](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/tree/pre-edge0-infer)）。 - **【2026-09-16】** 技术报告上线 arXiv：[The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18063)。 - **【2026-09-08】** **edge0** 首次开源发布，两个模型档位 [`Edge0-35B-A3B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) 与 [`Edge0-8B-A1B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) 同步登陆 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope。 ## 关于 edge0 **edge0** 是一个开源的流式 MoE 推理框架：把「SSD 专家 offload + Recover-LoRA + prerouter 路由预判」抽象成可扩展的通用框架，让大型稀疏 MoE 模型跑在消费级硬件上——峰值内存由**激活**专家集而非参数量决定。 ### 核心机制 - **SSD 专家 offload**：专家权重按需从存储流式加载，峰值内存由 激活集而非参数量决定； - **prerouter**：训练头提前一步预测专家路由，专家装载与前向计算重叠 而非阻塞——解码吞吐**最高 +59%**，收益随存储延迟、模型规模与路由 宽度 *K* 增大； - **Recover-LoRA**：冻结 int4 基模，用 FP teacher 蒸馏训练 LoRA， 在 4bit 下恢复绝大部分量化损失（见[质量](#质量)）。适配器与基模 分开存放，可单独开关。 ### 平台 一个引擎、一套原生 API，四端共用同一份代码，见 [`edge0-infer/`](edge0-infer/README_zh.md)： | 平台 | 后端 | 验证设备 | |---|---|---| | **macOS**（Apple Silicon） | Metal、CPU | Apple M5，16 GiB | | **iOS** | Metal | iPhone 17 Pro Max | | **Android** | CPU | OnePlus PKR110（骁龙 8 Elite） | | **Windows**（x86-64） | CPU、Vulkan | Intel Core i5-12400，NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER | prefill 与 decode 可以用同一设备上的不同后端，例如 Metal prefill + CPU decode。 桌面（macOS、Windows）、Android、iOS 的对话 App 示例见 [`edge0-infer/examples/`](edge0-infer/examples/README.md#chat-applications)。 ### 模型 框架随附两个模型档位。每个档位是一个端到端发布：发布的 checkpoint、 训练好的 LoRA 适配器与训练好的 prerouter 头作为整体协同工作。 | 档位 | 发布 checkpoint | 推理档 | edge0-infer | |---|---|---|---| | `edge0-35b` | [`Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) · [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) | 4bit，40 层，256 专家，prerouter K=4 | ✅ 已支持 | | `edge0-8b` | [`Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) · [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) | 4bit，24 层，128 专家，prerouter K=8 | 计划中 | 两个 checkpoint 均基于开源稀疏 MoE 基座（分别为 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 与 Ling 3.0 混合架构），并携带为本框架训练的 LoRA 与 prerouter 权重。 edge0-infer 用自带的资产工具下载发布的 checkpoint，并转换成引擎的模型 资产（见[快速开始](#快速开始)）。 ### 设计 - **基于 GGML、四端同一份代码**：原生库只依赖固定版本、原样内置的 GGML， 构建时不下载任何东西； - **一套原生 API**：应用链接 CMake 目标 `edge0::edge0`、包含 `include/edge0/` 下的头文件即可在进程内使用引擎；参考 CLI 与 OpenAI 兼容服务使用与原生 API 相同的配置与默认值； - **专家按需读入**：路由专家从存储按需读入每层固定数量的专家槽，比 设备内存预算更大的模型无需整体载入内存即可运行； - **两种路由模式**：`predicted`（默认）用 prerouter 在当前 token 计算时 后台准备下一个 token 的专家；`actual` 为模型原始计算，用于对照； - **多轮复用**：多轮对话中通常只计算每轮的新消息，之前的计算结果直接 复用。 详见 [edge0-infer 架构](edge0-infer/docs/architecture.md)。 ### 质量 全部评测由我们使用 [OpenCompass](https://github.com/open-compass/opencompass)、 在完全相同的设置与参数下对 edge0 模型（int4 + 训练适配器 + prerouter 路由） 与原 fp16 基座模型测得。edge0 管线的损失很小：**edge0-35b 平均仅落后 3.9 分、edge0-8b 落后 2.8 分**（MMLU-Pro 甚至反超基座）。满分 100： | 评测集 | edge0-35b（int4） | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（fp16） | edge0-8b（int4） | Ling 3.0 tiny（fp16） | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | AIME 2026 | 86.6 | 92.7 | 63.3 | 73.3 | | HumanEval | 90.9 | 95.1 | 91.5 | 92.7 | | GPQA-Diamond | 79.8 | 81.8 | 70.7 | 71.2 | | MMLU-Pro | 81.0 | 84.6 | 70.1 | 65.8 | | IFBench | 57.9 | 61.7 | 53.9 | 60.6 | | **平均** | **79.2** | **83.2** | **69.9** | **72.7** | ### 性能实测 `edge0-35b`、`predicted` 路由，在 edge0-infer 上实测（每项为三个进程的最小值到最大值）： | 平台 | 设备 | 输入 | 首 token | 解码速度 | 以下命令都在 `edge0-infer/` 目录下运行。需要 CMake 3.21+、Ninja、C++17/C11 编译器、uv 与 Git；35B 的原始权重约 18 GB、转换后的资产约 20 GB，转换时还需要 同样大小的空闲空间。 ### 1) 构建 ```bash cd edge0-infer cmake --preset mac-metal && cmake --build --preset mac-metal build/mac-metal/bin/edge0-infer info # 应输出一行：model.0: edge0_35b ``` 没有 Metal 的机器用 `--preset cpu`、`build/cpu/bin/edge0-infer`，并在下面的命令里 用 `--device cpu`。 ### 2) 下载并转换模型资产 ```bash export MOE_SOURCE_35B=<存放原始权重的目录> export MOE_ASSETS_35B=<存放转换后资产的目录> uv sync --project tools/assets assets_py() { uv run --project tools/assets --offline --no-sync python -I "$@"; } assets_py tools/assets/edge0_35b/fetch_source.py download --out "$MOE_SOURCE_35B" assets_py tools/assets/edge0_35b/make_assets.py --source "$MOE_SOURCE_35B" --out "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" assets_py tools/assets/check_assets.py check "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" ``` 下载的是 Hugging Face 上的 `Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview`，按锁定的版本与 摘要校验。 ### 3) 运行 ```bash # 单轮 build/mac-metal/bin/edge0-infer run --model "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" --device metal --user "用一句话介绍你自己。" # 多轮对话 build/mac-metal/bin/edge0-infer chat --model "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" --device metal # 起服务（OpenAI 兼容，默认 http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1） build/mac-metal/bin/edge0-infer serve --model "$MOE_ASSETS_35B" --device metal ``` Android、Windows、iOS 的构建，以及在自己的 CMake 工程中使用引擎，见 [Getting started](edge0-infer/docs/getting-started.md)。 ## 文档 **模型** - macOS、iOS、Android、Windows。 - **edge0-infer 支持 `edge0-8b`**。 **模型与算法** Q4 推进两条主线：把下一代架构引入框架，以及把潜在推理（latent thinking）变成真正的延迟收益、而不只是算力节省。 - **下一代架构支持（Qwen3.8-Flash 级）** —— 在 edge0 上跑通混合线性 注意力（GDN + QSA）、门控多分支残差、N-gram embedding 拓扑。这些 设计天然契合 SSD 流式 offload：O(1) 状态的注意力层让长思考不再是 KV cache 问题，纯查表的 N-gram 表按需流式加载。目标：该档位在单 设备跑通，且基准与 fp16 基座的差距在可接受范围内。 - **潜在思考 + 批量专家预预测** —— 让潜在推理成为*延迟*收益，而不 只是算力收益。核心工程问题：把专家路由从 per-position 改为**每 block 一次**，一次预测覆盖一个 block 内所有位置与所有轮次，使**专家加载量 与推理循环次数解耦**；配合跨 block 预取，在当前 block 的计算窗口内 加载下一个 block 的专家集。进展以**等准确率下的端到端思考阶段耗时** 衡量（而非 tokens/s）。 - 更多模型档位与适配器版本在现有管线上持续发布。 ## 贡献 欢迎各种形式的贡献——issue、PR、性能实测报告、新模型接入都算。 构建与测试见 [Testing](edge0-infer/docs/testing.md)，不需要模型资产的检查： ```bash cd edge0-infer cmake --preset cpu && cmake --build --preset cpu
